# HTML mail fixtures

MIT-licensed upstream email templates adapted with fictional content for rendering and remote-image blocking tests. These are public template examples, not captured customer messages. Original layout, styles, media queries, and conditional comments are retained. Generated gradient PNGs replace upstream image sources; two additional `https://remote.test/` images per fixture intentionally remain remote. Full upstream license notices are embedded in each HTML file.

Each entry records the pinned source, license, project, and exact assertion values.

- `postmark-receipt.html` — source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ActiveCampaign/postmark-templates/fa73527acb4eb59cf673a54572d213e908f1515c/templates-inlined/basic-full/receipt/content.html; license: [MIT](https://github.com/ActiveCampaign/postmark-templates/blob/fa73527acb4eb59cf673a54572d213e908f1515c/LICENSE); project: ActiveCampaign/postmark-templates; button: **Download as PDF** → `https://northstar.test/receipts/R-1042.pdf`; text: “Your annual workspace subscription is paid through November 2027.”
